Headquarters: Remote Roles - EMEA

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the team

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.

About the Opportunity

This is an essential, high-profile role at one of the fastest-growing global cryptocurrency exchanges in Europe. The Deputy General Counsel will play a central role in proactively shaping OKX's regulatory and legal strategy in the EEA.

As Deputy General Counsel and Head of Legal, EEA, you will lead the EEA legal function, working closely with the EEA CEO and other key stakeholders and reporting into the Global Legal team. You will be providing strategic legal and regulatory guidance for OKX’s European entity and supporting business operations across the region. This role combines hands-on legal management, cross-functional advisory, and strategic leadership in an evolving regulatory and crypto landscape.

You will be a member of the EU management team and represent the legal function at relevant Board and committee meetings.

The right candidate will have direct legal experience and an enthusiastic belief in the digital asset space, 14+ years of experience working for a top-tier law firm, in-house at a financial services or digital assets company or with a financial services regulator and possess excellent writing and analytical skills. The ideal candidate has deep experience in financial services and digital asset regulation, EEA regulation, marketing and advertising, and contract law.

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Supporting OKX's business expansion in the EEA. This role will be the primary legal point of contact for the OKX EEA entity, and will be called upon to support the business in its licensing and legal efforts to expand into the U.K. Market. The right candidate will also have experience in managing a team and representing OKX in relevant industry associations and promoting OKX's view point in consultation efforts.

Supporting the business in virtually all legal coverage areas, including but not limited to:

• Product development, regulatory matters, IP and trademark enforcement, corporate governance, licensing efforts, token listings for OKX Europe., contract negotiation, compliance legal support, institutional sales and partnerships, and marketing and advertising.

• 

Analyzing and advising on the legal risk of new and existing digital assets and managing the legal component of the new asset review process;

• 

Lead and manage lawyers covering the EEA so that legal efforts are coordinated and consistently achieve successful outcomes;

• 

Collaborating with product and business development teams to achieve company-wide projects and goals; and

• 

Managing legal requests from all areas of the business and effectively advising on legal concepts and legal risk with an eye towards the strategic goals of business leaders.

You will spend a minimum of 50% of your time working from OKX's Malta based office.

What We Look For In You 

• 

Strong communication and leadership skills, and excellent judgment

• 

Self-starter who can contribute as both an individual and a team member, with limited reliance upon external counsel.

• 

Law degree at a top-tier law school and qualified to practice law in the EEA.

• 

14+ years of legal experience at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house legal team, preferably in the cryptocurrency/digital assets and/or financial services industry.

• 

Experience advising on digital asset and blockchain technology legal issues and have a strong understanding of the relevant legal and regulatory landscape.

• 

Experience working with EU regulators and maintaining EU financial services and/or crypto exchange licenses.

• 

Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment.

• 

Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.

• 

Ability to navigate through a rapidly-changing legal landscape and deal with legal ambiguity.

• 

Ability to work in a high-functioning legal team and feel comfortable in a collaborative working environment.

• 

Experience working on cross-jurisdictional matters and a global legal team.

Perks & Benefits 

• 

Competitive total compensation package

• 

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

• 

Various team building programs and company events

• 

Wellness and meal allowances 

• 

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents

• 

More that we love to tell you along the process!

de405bef30e55b1e.description:
About Norm
Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.
Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.
Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.
Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role
We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week.
The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction.

How You'll Work
The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call.
You Will
• 
Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week.
• 
Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager.
• 
Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers.
• 
Run on-call escalation.
• 
Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team.
• 
Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it.

Skills & Experience - Core
• 
Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience
• 
8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code
• 
Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS
• 
Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it
• 
Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients
• 
Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising
• 
Clear, brief writing

Skills & Experience - Pluses
• 
Clients in financial services or another regulated industry
• 
Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal
• 
Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero

What Success Looks Like - 90 Days
• 
You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team
• 
You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation
• 
The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working

Comp and Benefits
$220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity.

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Employees enjoy top-tier insurance coverage, encompassing health, dental, hospital, accident, and vision plans. You'll thrive in our fast-paced learning environment where professional growth is constant.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with core hours on US Eastern time. You will start in our New York office at One World Trade Center. Norm employment, US residency and work performed from the US are conditions of the role; because our clients are financial institutions, offers are conditional on a background check, including E-Verify. Visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

If you're interested in the role but aren't sure whether you're a good fit, we'd still like to hear from you.
To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

de48603967e945cf.description: Build the AI agents, sync engine, and full-stack product that keep enterprise CRMs and cloud partner programs in lockstep, and own them in production. Title : Senior Software Engineer (Cloud & AI) Experience : 5+ years of professional software engineering. Core stack : Python, TypeScript/React, Go, AWS, GCP, Azure, LLMs Location : Bengaluru, India (in-office) Employment type : Full-time About Labra Labra builds cloud-native B2B SaaS products powered by AI agents that help companies accelerate their cloud transformation. Our teams work at the intersection of generative AI, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and modern full-stack engineering, shipping products that customers and internal teams use every day. The Role This is a hands-on role with real scope across three areas: AI agents and LLM features, the backend and sync engine, and the React product customers use. Your depth can be in one area, as long as you're comfortable working across all three. You'll join a pod that pairs feature work with stability work. You'll take problems from a half-formed customer need to architecting a feature running reliably in production: designing the system, writing most of the code, reviewing teammates' work, and being accountable for how it behaves once it ships. What You'll Own 1. AI agents and LLM features 2. Build production AI agents and LLM features with RAG, tool calling, and MCP-based workflows. 3. Design context management: memory, compression, retrieval and prompt optimization. 4.Optimize for time to first token (TTFT), latency, token usage, and cost through caching, parallel tool execution, and reducing unnecessary LLM calls. 5.Ship streaming AI experiences over SSE and WebSockets. Sync engine and integrations 1.Design, build and ship modules for various business systems’ (such as CRM, ERPs) integrations, sync configuration and co-sell pipeline visibility. 2.Make high-volume, bidirectional sync between CRMs and cloud partner programs fast, correct and recoverable. 3.Build event-driven processing on AWS SQS, EventBridge, SNS, Lambda, and Step Functions, with robust retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling. Full-stack product 1.Build customer-facing features in React and TypeScript, backed by well-designed REST APIs and services in Python or Go. 2.Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure third-party integrations. 3.Profile slow endpoints and queries, tune connection pools and aggregation pipelines, and load-test before customers hit the limits. 4.Write automation and unit tests for the code before it is deployed. Production and engineering quality 1.Add the metrics, logs, traces, and alerts that catch issues first, and cut alert noise so real signals stand out. 2.Join the on-call rotation, lead incident debugging, and ship root-cause fixes rather than patches. 3.Improve scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency on AWS. 4.Write design docs, review code, raise test coverage, and mentor junior engineers in your pod. Our Stack You don't need all of this on day one. Strong fundamentals in one language and one database matter more. Area & What we use Languages : Python (primary), TypeScript, Go Frontend : React, TypeScript Backend frameworks : FastAPI, Flask, NestJS AI and LLMs : Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Claude, MCP, LangChain / LangGraph Data and search : PostgreSQL (RDS), MongoDB / DocumentDB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch Async and messaging : AWS SQS, SNS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge Cloud and infra : AWS (ECS Fargate, IAM, S3), GCP (Cloud Run), Azure, Docker, Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins Integrations : Salesforce APIs (incl. Bulk API, Canvas), HubSpot, AWS ACE, Workato AI development tools : Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code What You Bring 1.5+ years building and running software in production, ideally in a B2B SaaS product. 2.Strong Python or Go, TypeScript with a willingness to work mainly in Python. 3.Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript for production frontends. 4.Solid REST API design and experience with microservices, distributed systems and asynchronous processing, ideally on AWS SQS, SNS and Lambda: queues, retries, idempotency and failure handling. 5.Depth in at least one relational database (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and one NoSQL store (MongoDB or 6.DynamoDB): schema design, indexing and query tuning. 7.Experience building or integrating LLM features, AI agents, RAG or tool-calling systems, with a working grasp of context windows, token management and retrieval. 8.Understanding of TTFT, streaming, latency optimization and caching. 9.Hands-on AWS (and Azure or GCP) production deployments, plus Docker, Git, CI/CD and automated testing. 10.Comfort debugging production issues from logs, metrics and traces. 11.A track record of owning a feature or service from design through production support. 12.Clear written communication: design docs, tickets and updates people can act on. 13.Very important - Proven track record of mentoring and developing junior team members. Nice to Have 1.Hands-on work with MCP servers or clients, Amazon Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore. 2.Agent orchestration with LangChain or LangGraph, and LLM evaluation, guardrails, or agent observability. 3.Workflow orchestration with Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions, or Celery. 4.CRM integration experience, especially Salesforce or HubSpot APIs. 5.OpenSearch or other vector and search engines for retrieval. 6.Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation. 7.Load testing (k6, Locust) and observability tooling. 8.Familiarity with cloud partner programs or marketplaces (AWS ACE, Azure, GCP). How We Work We're a fast-paced startup where a small team ships to large enterprises, and priorities shift with customer needs. You'll thrive here if you: 1.Act like an owner. Your service's uptime, performance, and customer impact are yours, not someone else's ticket. 2.Close the loop. Merged isn't done. You confirm it works in production and follow up until the customer's problem is solved. 3.Move fast without breaking trust. You ship in small, safe increments and know when a shortcut will cost us later. 4.Handle ambiguity. Given a half-formed problem, you ask sharp questions, propose a plan and get moving. 5.Raise problems early. You flag risks, slips and bad ideas, including your own, before they become surprises. 6.Keep learning. You try new AI, agent and cloud tools and bring back what works. 7.Lift the team. You review carefully, share context in writing and help newer engineers level up. What You Get 1.AI in production, not prototypes. Ship agents, RAG, and LLM features that enterprise customers use every day. 2.Hard performance problems. Work on TTFT, streaming, token cost, and high-volume sync at enterprise scale. 3.Real ownership. Own high-impact systems that customer revenue depends on, from design through on-call. 4.Direct customer exposure. Work on enterprise customers' actual problems, not just tickets about them. 5.Room to grow. Shape our platform’s architecture and follow a clear path toward pod lead or tech lead. How to Apply We would love to see what you have built. Send your resume with links to your GitHub or any projects using LLMs or AI agents or any open source contribution.

deead1e09273d094.description: Company: ContexQ Location: Singapore / India / Malaysia (Remote/Hybrid) At ContexQ, we are fundamentally reshaping the emerging landscape of Contextual Decision Intelligence. We leverage cutting-edge composite AI, Vector Search, and advanced graph technology to resolve billions of entities continuously. By uncovering hidden relationships, we revolutionize how global enterprises handle fraud detection, financial crime (AML), risk management, and supply chain intelligence. We are an ambitious, fast-moving startup taking on massive enterprise big data challenges, and we are looking for a Founding Knowledge Graph Scientist to push the boundaries of what is possible in semantic data resolution and network graph AI. This is not a traditional corporate research role. We are looking for an elite AI researcher and practitioner with a PhD and the DNA of an entrepreneur—someone who can architect novel Graph Transformer architectures, develop cutting-edge explainable AI (XAI) models for fraud detection, and translate deep academic expertise into high-impact enterprise solutions. You will be at the forefront of designing the intelligence engine that protects global financial institutions from complex, coordinated financial crimes. THE MISSION As our Founding Knowledge Graph Scientist, you are the intellectual and technical force behind our core AI reasoning engine. You will bridge the gap between state-of-the-art academic research in graph neural networks and the practical, high-throughput demands of enterprise anti-money laundering (AML) and fraud detection systems. Your ultimate metric is the accuracy, efficiency, and explainability of our graph-based AI models. You will architect proprietary knowledge graph structures, implement advanced Graph Transformer models (like FraudGT or similar architectures), and create the analytical "awe factor" that proves to C-suite banking executives that ContexQ can catch financial crime that legacy systems miss. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Architect the Graph: Design and optimize large-scale financial knowledge graphs that capture complex temporal, spatial, and transactional relationships across billions of nodes and edges to detect collusion and laundering behaviors. • Pioneer AI Models: Develop, train, and deploy advanced Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Transformers specifically tailored for highly imbalanced, large-scale financial data. • Drive XAI in FinCrime: Champion model transparency by building explainable AI mechanisms that allow compliance officers to understand exactly why a transaction or entity was flagged, ensuring strict adherence to global banking regulations. • Bridge Research & Product: Act as the crucial link between theoretical AI research and our core product roadmap. Publish findings, stay ahead of state-of-the-art fraud detection methodologies, and directly implement these breakthroughs into the ContexQ platform. • Collaborate Across Teams: Work seamlessly with Data Engineering, MLOps, and Business Analysts to ensure your graph models are deployed efficiently, scale securely, and directly address the pain points of our enterprise clients. WHO YOU ARE • The Deep Expert: You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field, with a heavy research focus on Knowledge Graphs, Graph Neural Networks, or Graph Transformers. • Domain Specialized: You possess deep expertise (either academic or applied) in utilizing graph analytics for anomaly detection, specifically within the realms of Financial Crime, Fraud detection, or cybersecurity. • A Proven Builder: You have a track record of translating complex AI theory into functional code (PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, DGL). You are not just a theoretician; you can build, test, and optimize models for real-world deployment. • A Master Communicator: You can distill complex mathematical concepts and graph topologies into clear, compelling narratives for both highly technical engineering teams and non-technical business stakeholders. COMPENSATION & THE CONTEXQ UPSIDE We are explicitly looking for top-tier research and engineering talent who wants to bet on themselves, act as true owners, and build foundational technology. We structure compensation to heavily reward dedication, innovation, and long-term impact. In exchange for your deep expertise and technical leadership, we offer competitive compensation, significant early-stage foundational equity worth up to $1,000,000 USD over time, a high-impact remote-first culture, and a structure designed to directly align your wealth creation with the platform's enterprise valuation. This role is designed for an AI pioneer who wants real skin in the game. If you are looking for a purely academic sandbox with no commercial pressure, this isn't for you. If you want the massive upside of building an enterprise AI juggernaut from the ground up and sharing directly in the value you create by stopping global financial crime, you belong at ContexQ.

You know a great technical sale is about more than delivering a polished demo. You'll need enough technical depth to comfortably navigate conversations across security operations, incident response, SIEM, endpoint, network, and cloud environments. But being the smartest technical person in the room isn't enough. We're looking for someone who can listen, ask great questions, tell a compelling technical story, challenge assumptions when necessary, and build trust with everyone from a SOC analyst to a CISO.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You'll be expected to independently navigate our hardest opportunities, influence people who don't report to you, hold teams accountable when necessary, and help make the broader Solutions Architecture organization better along the way.

Sound like your kind of challenge? We'd like to hear from you.

What Expel can do for you

• Put you at the center of complex Enterprise security opportunities where your technical judgment can directly influence both the sale and the long-term customer relationship.

• Give you ownership across the technical sales lifecycle, from discovery and demos through POVs, technical objections, escalations, and the transition into service delivery.

• Expose you to a wide range of Enterprise security environments across SIEM, endpoint, network, cloud, identity, security operations, and detection and response.

• Connect you with experienced Account Executives, Sales leaders, SOC analysts, Detection & Response, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Service Delivery teams.

• Give you the autonomy to solve difficult customer problems creatively while maintaining the integrity to be clear about what Expel can and cannot do.

• Give you the opportunity to influence how we run POVs, approach Enterprise opportunities, transition customers into delivery, and improve the overall Solutions Architecture motion.

• Let you remain deeply connected to customers and technical work while operating with Principal-level visibility and influence across the business.

• Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, SOC, Detection & Response, Customer Success, and Delivery, influencing and holding stakeholders accountable even when they don't report to you.

• Maintain strong working knowledge across SIEM, endpoint/EDR, network, cloud, security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, and detection and response.

• Identify opportunities to improve our POV methodology, technical content, processes, customer handoffs, and internal enablement, then work across teams to actually implement those improvements.

• Raise the technical and consultative bar for the broader Solutions Architecture team by sharing what you learn and helping others navigate difficult customer and technical situations.

What you should bring with you

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, technical security selling, security consulting, security operations, incident response, or similar customer-facing security roles.

• A track record of operating at a senior or principal level, regardless of your current title. You can independently own complex Enterprise opportunities, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and become the technical person others trust when the answer isn't obvious.

• Meaningful experience leading complex Enterprise POVs, including technical discovery, defining success criteria, coordinating execution, managing objections, troubleshooting issues, and connecting technical outcomes back to customer goals.

• Strong security depth with the ability to confidently discuss security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, network architecture, cloud environments, SIEM, endpoint/EDR, and detection and response.

• The ability to understand how security technologies work together in real customer environments and identify where technology alone doesn't solve the underlying problem.

• Strong storytelling skills. You can take something technically complicated and make it understandable, relevant, and compelling for a SOC analyst, security engineer, Account Executive, or CISO.

• Trusted-advisor instincts. You look beyond what a customer initially asks for, uncover what they're actually trying to accomplish, and aren't afraid to respectfully challenge a proposed approach.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills with experience coordinating complex work and holding others accountable without relying on formal authority.

• High EQ and the ability to navigate disagreement, conflicting priorities, and difficult customer conversations without losing trust.

• Genuine curiosity. You ask thoughtful questions, dig beyond surface-level answers, and continuously invest in understanding security, technology, customers, and the business.

• Coachability and a low-ego approach to feedback. You don't need to know everything, but you should want to keep getting better.

• A track record of improving processes, technical strategy, enablement, customer deliverables, or team practices beyond your own individual opportunities.

Bonus points for...

• Hands-on experience working in a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, or another security operations environment.

• Experience selling or delivering MDR, MSSP, SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud security, or other security operations solutions.

• Experience supporting large Enterprise customers with complex environments, long sales cycles, and multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

• Experience working directly with Delivery or Customer Success after the sale rather than ending your involvement when the contract is signed.

• Experience responding to complex Enterprise RFPs and RFIs.

• Experience improving POV methodology, technical enablement, reusable content, or processes for a broader Solutions …
